arxiv-1701-06557.title: Some New Possible Anticipated Signals for Existence of Magnetic Monopoles Note: Not to appear in Nonlearned J., 45.
arxiv-1701-06557.creator: Qiu-He Peng , Jing-Jing, Liu , and Zhong-Qi, Ma
arxiv-1701-06557.description: Abstract We summarize some predictions from the model of supermassive object with magnetic monopoles which match up with recent astronomical observations quantitatively. They may be the signals for existence of magnetic monopoles in the supermassive objects, such as one at the Galactic Center.

arxiv-2001-08694.title: Solutions to the Dirac equation in the background of 1 monopole with 2 singularities
arxiv-2001-08694.creator: Thomas Harris
arxiv-2001-08694.description: Abstract We use the Nahm transform to construct explicit L 2 L^{2} solutions to the Dirac equation in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} in the background of one nonabelian U ⁡ ( 2 ) U(2) monopole with one positive and one negative Dirac singularity.

arxiv-2104-10219.title: Scalable Synthesis of Verified Controllers in Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2104-10219.creator: Zikang Xiong, Suresh Jagannathan
arxiv-2104-10219.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Zikang Xiong, Suresh Jagannathan. There has been significant recent interest in devising verification techniques for learning-enabled controllers (LECs) that manage safety-critical systems. Given the opacity and lack of interpretability of the neural policies that govern the behavior of such controllers, many existing approaches enforce safety properties through shield, a dynamic monitoring-and-repairing mechanism that ensures a LEC does not emit actions that would violate desired safety conditions.

arxiv-2105-02385.title: A Gladyshev theorem for trifractional Brownian motion and n n -th order fractional Brownian motion
arxiv-2105-02385.creator: Xiyue Han
arxiv-2105-02385.description: Abstract We prove limit theorems for the weighted quadratic variation of trifractional Brownian motion and n n -th order fractional Brownian motion. Furthermore, a sufficient condition for the L P L^{P} -convergence of the weighted quadratic variation for Gaussian processes is obtained as a byproduct.

arxiv-2207-04816.title: A Steklov version of the torsional rigidity
arxiv-2207-04816.creator: Lorenzo Brasco, María del Mar González, Mikel Ispizua
arxiv-2207-04816.description: Abstract . Motivated by the connection between the first eigenvalue of the Dirichlet-Laplacian and the torsional rigidity, the aim of this paper is to find a physically coherent and mathematically interesting new concept for boundary torsional rigidity, closely related to the Steklov eigenvalue.

arxiv-2209-05570.title: Attention Capture
arxiv-2209-05570.creator: Andrew Koh, Sivakorn Sanguanmoo
arxiv-2209-05570.description: Abstract We develop a unified analysis of how information captures attention. A decision maker (DM) faces a dynamic information structure and decides when to stop paying attention. We characterize the convex-order frontier and extreme points of feasible stopping times, as well as dynamic information structures which implement them.

arxiv-2302-00157.description: Abstract In this paper, we extend results of Eigenvector Thermalization to the case of generalized Wigner matrices. plos-pone-0012627.description: PLOS ONE research article. The ERK5 cascade is a MAPK pathway that transmits both mitogenic and stress signals, yet its mechanism of activation is not fully understood. Using intracellular calcium modifiers, we found that ERK5 activation by EGF is inhibited both by the depletion and elevation of intracellu

pmc-10595236.title: Socioeconomic Disparities in Beliefs about Cancer: Irish National Cancer Awareness Survey
pmc-10595236.creator: C O'Hare, T McCarthy, L Mullen, K Bennett
pmc-10595236.description: For most tumour types survival varies according to socioeconomic position (SEP) and stage at diagnosis. The aim of this study was to examine the association between SEP and beliefs about cancer, and the impact of beliefs on symptom awareness and help-seeking.

pmc-10638812.title: Estimating and visualising the trade-off between benefits and harms on multiple clinical outcomes in network meta-analysis
pmc-10638812.creator: Virginia Chiocchia, Toshi A. Furukawa, Johannes Schneider-Thoma, Spyridon Siafis, Andrea Cipriani, Stefan Leucht, Georgia Salanti
pmc-10638812.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundThe relative treatment effects estimated from network meta-analysis can be employed to rank treatments from the most preferable to the least preferable option. These treatment hierarchies are typically based on ranking metrics calculated from a single outcome.

pmc-11476228.title: Role of Imaging in Screening for Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-11476228.creator: Irfan A. Kazi, Vinay Jahagirdar, Bareen W. Kabir, Almaan K. Syed, Asad W. Kabir, Abhilash Perisetti
pmc-11476228.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryLiver cancer ranks as the sixth most common type of cancer and is the third leading cause of cancer deaths. The most frequent type of liver cancer is hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), making up about 90% of these cases. HCC mainly occurs in people who have cirrhosis, a serious liver condition often caused by chronic liver diseases like hepatitis B and C or long-term heavy alcohol intake.

pmc-11590209.title: Survival trends of patients with metaplastic breast carcinoma with different hormone receptor statuses: a SEER-based retrospective cohort study
pmc-11590209.creator: Zhiming Miao, Futing Ba, Zechao Wen, Kai Chen, Xiang Shen, Feng Gen, Yinlong Yang
pmc-11590209.description: BackgroundMetaplastic breast carcinoma (MpBC) is a rare histological subtype of breast cancer, and its prognosis is relatively poor. The survival trend of MpBC with different hormone receptor statuses has remained unclear over the past two decades.MethodsMpBC patient data were collected from the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results database from 2000 to 2019.

pmc-12508074.title: A dataset of study program availability in German higher education between 1971 and 1996
pmc-12508074.creator: Boris Thome, Friederike Hertweck, Serife Yasar, Lukas Jonas, Stefan Conrad
pmc-12508074.description: Educational systems are dynamic. They shape human capital, technological and societal progress, and also economic growth. Higher education, in particular, fosters innovation, with varying fields of study contributing differently to this process. Yet, despite its importance, no dataset has previously documented the evolution of academic fields across higher education institutions in a specific country.

pmc-12605869.title: Comprehensive Analysis of the PANoptosis-Related Genes in Stroke Based on Single-Cell RNA-Seq and Spatial Transcriptomics
pmc-12605869.creator: Wenya Bai, Huan Jiang, Guilin Zhou, Xuelian Li, Jianlin Shao
pmc-12605869.description: BackgroundPANoptosis is implicated in immunoinflammatory diseases, but its role in cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury (CIRI) remains unclear.MethodsWe integrated single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), spatial transcriptomics (ST), and bulk RNA-sequencing (bulk RNA-seq) datasets to explore PANoptosis-related molecular signatures in ischemic stroke. scRNA-seq identified cellular subpopulations; ST revealed spatial expression.

pmc-12630119.title: MobileNet-GDR: a lightweight algorithm for grape leaf disease identification based on improved MobileNetV4-small
pmc-12630119.creator: Gang Chen, Zhennan Xia, Xiaodan Ma, Yiyang Jiang, Zhuang He
pmc-12630119.description: To address the challenges of high computational complexity and difficult deployment of existing deep learning models on mobile devices for grape leaf disease diagnosis, this paper proposes a lightweight image classification algorithm named MobileNet-GDR (Grape Disease Recognition), built upon the MobileNetV4-small architecture.

pmc-12650746.title: Deep Learning Model-Based Architectures for Lung Tumor Mutation Profiling: A Systematic Review
pmc-12650746.creator: Samanta Ortuño-Miquel, Reyes Roca, Cristina Alenda, Francisco Aranda, Natividad Martínez-Banaclocha, Sandra Amador, David Gil, Xia Jiang
pmc-12650746.description: Simple SummaryLung cancer is a leading cause of cancer-related deaths worldwide, and understanding the genetic mutations that drive tumor growth is crucial for improving diagnosis and treatment. This study systematically reviews recent research using deep learning approaches to analyze lung tumor mutations, particularly in non-small-cell lung cancer.

pmc-13008898.title: Rus-GXF, a ruscogenin glycoside, binds to the ADP-binding domain of JAK1 to prevent inflammation and barrier damage in acute lung injury
pmc-13008898.creator: Long Liu, Xu Duan, Mei-Qi Li, Yi Gu, Jia-He Zhao, Kai-Shuai Si, Nan-Nan Wang, Xing-Fu Chen, Zhong-Qiong Yin, Li-Xia Li, Xun Zhou, Chun Wu, Meng-Liang Tian, Yuan-Feng Zou
pmc-13008898.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundRuscogenin-1-O-[β-D-glucopyranosyl (1→2)][β-D-xylopyranosyl (1→3)] -β-D-fucopyranoside (Rus-GXF) is a ruscogenin glycoside of Liriope muscari (Decaisne) L. Bailey, yet its protective effects against acute lung injury—a condition characterized by exacerbated inflammation and barrier damage have not been fully elucidated.MethodsIn this study, the preventive and therapeutic effects of Rus-GXF on acute lung injury (ALI) were investigated using transcriptome RNA sequencing, network pharmacology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation and other in vitro and in vivo experiments.ResultsRus-GXF suppressed inflammatory responses in two key cell types involved in lung

pmc-13361740.title: Beyond the leaves: functional role of chlorophyllous stems in tomato (Solanum lycopersicum L.) and their impact on nitrogen balance and root development
pmc-13361740.creator: Miron Gieniec, Andrzej Kornaś, Maciej Kocurek, Marzena Sujkowska-Rybkowska, Isabel Nogués, Emanuele Pallozzi, Walter Stefanoni, Zbigniew Miszalski
pmc-13361740.description: BackgroundPhotosynthetic activity in plant stems, particularly in woody plants and shrubs, is well known and documented. Nevertheless, our knowledge about the role of photochemical processes occurring in the stems of cultivated plants and their contribution to plant growth and development, including the root system, still remains unclear.

pmc-13371600.title: Comparative safety and efficacy of hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy combined with targeted therapy and immunotherapy, with or without transarterial chemoembolization, in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma: a multicenter retrospective cohort study
pmc-13371600.creator: Ruibing Zhou, Ze Zhang, Xiaoxv Yin, Yi Zhang, Weipeng Yan, Anhui Xu, Ketao Mu
pmc-13371600.description: BackgroundInterventional therapies and systemic chemotherapy are the mainstay of treatment for patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). This study aimed to generate preliminary evidence regarding the feasibility and safety of transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) combined with hepatic artery infusion chemotherapy (HAIC), targeted therapy, and immunotherapy in patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).

pmc-13506495.title: How information and communication overload impairs creative performance in the digital technology age: the chain mediating roles of emotion and state self-control
pmc-13506495.creator: Meng Yang, Siyu Chen, Conghui Liu
pmc-13506495.description: IntroductionDespite the growing integration of digital technologies into work place innovation, information and communication overload in the age of pervasive digital devices remains under-researched regarding its impact on employee creativity. The present research examines the psychological mechanisms linking information and communication overload to creative performance.

pmc-13530630.title: Poster 36. Perioperative Nutritional Supplementation with Essential Amino Acids, Protein, and Creatine Enhances Quadriceps Recovery After ACL Reconstruction in Active-Duty Military Soldiers: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13530630.creator: Christian A Cruz, Valentina Ramirez
pmc-13530630.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Objective:Quadriceps atrophy and strength deficits following anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) reconstruction remain major barriers to return-to-duty and sport in military and athletic populations. While perioperative rehabilitation strategies have advanced, the role of preoperative nutritional optimization is not well established.
